lines.zh: 我头里的火苗一步一晃。
lines.en: The flame in my head sways with each step.
Vines wind from my ankles to my knees.
I step on fallen leaves, they crackle loud.

lines.zh: 南瓜籽洒在我走过的地方。
lines.en: Pumpkin seeds spill where I have walked.

lines.zh: 我的披风扫倒了干枯的玉米。
lines.en: My cloak knocks down the dry corn.

lines.zh: 蜡烛油顺着我脖子往下滴。
lines.en: Wax runs down my neck as I go.
Each of my steps lands like a drum.

lines.zh: 我绕着自己的地界走一圈。
lines.en: I walk the round of my own boundary.

lines.zh: 秋天到了，我的步子更沉。
lines.en: Autumn came and my step grew heavier.
I do not rush, the prey will wait.

lines.zh: 我头里的蜡烛快烧到底了。
lines.en: The candle in my head is burning low.
I wipe the ash off my pumpkin skin.
The vines grow slowly through the night.
I count my own pumpkin seeds.
A crow has landed on my horn.
I take my head off and look at it.
The flame inside turns once.
This field is what I planted.
The longer I wait, the brighter I burn.
The sweetness draws bugs, tiresome.
I scrape the rust off my blade.
My shadow is as long as a tree.
The night is cold, yet the fire stays.

lines.zh: 我记得每一个来过的人。
lines.en: I remember every one who came.

lines.zh: 藤蔓爬过我的脚背，很痒。
lines.en: Vines crawl over my feet, and it tickles.

lines.zh: 我在数今年能收几颗头。
lines.en: I count how many heads to harvest this year.
You are standing in my pumpkin field.

lines.zh: 我低下头，火照着你的脸。
lines.en: I lower my head, the flame lights your face.

lines.zh: 你闻起来像没熟的果子。
lines.en: You smell like fruit not yet ripe.

lines.zh: 我认得你身上那条木屑。
lines.en: I know the wood dust on your clothes.
You are staring at my head, yes?
Do not blink, my fire flickers.
Did you bring the elixir?

lines.zh: 我等你很久了，收割的人。
lines.en: I have waited long, reaper.
Your sickle is far too small.

lines.zh: 我歪一下头，火苗就偏了。
lines.en: I tilt my head and the flame leans.
Sweat on your face, still hot in autumn?

lines.zh: 我看着你，像看一株庄稼。
lines.en: I watch you the way one watches a crop.

lines.zh: 我的南瓜壳裂了一道缝。
lines.en: My pumpkin shell has split a seam.
The flame swayed, but held.
You struck the vine, it does not hurt.
Wax spatters out and burns my hand.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，地被我踩陷。
lines.en: I step back half a pace, the ground gives.
That cut shaved off a piece of my rind.
The fire in my head dimmed a moment.
You dare cut a scarecrow?
My blade has not touched the ground yet.
Pain proves I live, I accept it.

lines.zh: 你把南瓜举高些，我看不清。
lines.en: Raise that pumpkin higher, I cannot see.

lines.zh: 那瓶灵药，倒在我头上试试。
lines.en: Pour that elixir on my head, try it.
Sugar water at the roots makes me grow.

lines.zh: 南瓜举高些，我看不见你的脸。
lines.en: Hold the pumpkin higher — I cannot see your face.
Bring a pumpkin and I might listen.
Sweetness draws people, and bugs too.
What are you doing with that wheat?
Do not trade fruit for my patience.
My fire is already bright enough.
Your hands are sticky with pumpkin juice.
Run into me and you hit a tree stump.
You stepped on my vine, lift your foot.

lines.zh: 我的南瓜肚子晃了一下。
lines.en: My pumpkin belly wobbles.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，蜡会滴到你。
lines.en: Not so near, the wax will drip on you.

lines.zh: 你撞得我头上的火一跳。
lines.en: The bump made my head flame jump.

lines.zh: 我站在原地，你自己弹开。
lines.en: I stand still and you bounce off.

lines.zh: 我的护甲是南瓜皮，硬得很。
lines.en: My armor is pumpkin rind, hard as that.

lines.zh: 你退开，踩碎了我脚边的籽。
lines.en: You back off, crushing seeds at my feet.

lines.zh: 这一下撞掉了我的藤叶。
lines.en: That knock took off a vine leaf.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，藤自己伸过来。
lines.en: I stand my ground and the vines reach out on their own.
My fire lights only myself.
Pumpkins fruit every year, no hurry.
Were you planted too?

lines.zh: 两颗头靠一起，会烧起来。
lines.en: Two heads together would catch fire.
I speak only to my own vines.

lines.zh: 你身上没有籽，配不上我。
lines.en: You carry no seeds, you are not my match.
That waits until after the harvest.

lines.zh: 我把披风盖在你身上，够了。
lines.en: I lay my cloak over you, that is enough.
My roots are planted too deep.
Do not touch my fire, it burns.

lines.zh: 我捡起一颗南瓜，抱着走。
lines.en: I pick up a pumpkin and carry it.
This sickle on the ground is mine now.
I pick up a candle stub, still usable.

lines.zh: 这块布正好擦我的刀刃。
lines.en: This cloth will do to wipe my blade.

lines.zh: 我把种子一颗颗收进袋子。
lines.en: I gather the seeds one by one into a sack.
Someone dropped a hat, too small.

lines.zh: 我弯不下腰，只能踢着走。
lines.en: I cannot bend, so I kick it along.
This bundle of hay, I keep for bedding.
The iron is rusted, but still iron.
I pick it up because it shines.
Someone has crossed into my ground.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了我最好的南瓜。
lines.en: You crushed my best pumpkin.

lines.zh: 收割的季节，猎物自己来了。
lines.en: Harvest season, and the prey walks in.
I raise my head and the fire reaches far.
You carry the smell of elixir.
That name, I have written down.

lines.zh: 我握紧刀柄，藤也跟着紧。
lines.en: I grip my hilt and the vines tighten.

lines.zh: 你退得越远，我追得越久。
lines.en: The farther you run, the longer I chase.
This year's harvest includes you.
My fire has seen you.
Do not hide behind the haystack.
I come one step at a time, unhurried.
You have dirtied my field.
The lantern burns, you will not escape.

lines.zh: 稻草人只该站着，你偏来。
lines.en: A scarecrow should just stand; but you came.

lines.zh: 你腰间的剑，收割时碍事。
lines.en: That sword at your hip will get in the way.

lines.zh: 我的田里多了一个活物。
lines.en: There is one living thing too many in my field.

lines.zh: 别踩那根藤，它连着我的眼。
lines.en: Do not step on that vine; my eye is on it.

lines.zh: 我举刀，火苗拉成一条线。
lines.en: I raise the blade, the flame stretches thin.
You go left, my vines go left.
I bring it down and the ground splits.

lines.zh: 你的盾挡得住刀，挡不住火。
lines.en: Your shield stops steel, not fire.
Come close and the vines take you.

lines.zh: 正前方是我的刀落下的地方。
lines.en: Straight ahead is where my blade falls.
The fire in my head burns brighter.
Cut my vines and they grow again.

lines.zh: 我数你的脚步，三步之内。
lines.en: I count your steps, within three.

lines.zh: 这一刀会连人带甲一起砸。
lines.en: This blow takes armor and all.
You guard your legs, so I strike high.
My shadow reaches you first.

lines.zh: 你身后是篱笆，没有退路。
lines.en: The fence is behind you, no way back.

lines.zh: 火光晃眼，你分不清远近。
lines.en: The flames blur your sense of distance.

lines.zh: 我慢慢绕，绕到你身后去。
lines.en: I circle slowly, around to your back.

lines.zh: 你退到井边，井里也有我。
lines.en: You back to the well; I am in there too.

lines.zh: 我的刀拖在地上，声音很轻。
lines.en: My blade drags the ground, quietly.

lines.zh: 你砍断的那根，会再长回来。
lines.en: The vine you cut will grow back.

lines.zh: 火光把你的影子钉在墙上。
lines.en: The firelight pins your shadow to the wall.
I am waiting for your blade to slow.
The blade falls and sparks scatter.
I shattered the rim of your shield.
Vines climb from your ankle to your waist.

lines.zh: 这一下带着南瓜的重量。
lines.en: This blow carries the weight of a pumpkin.
The impact throws you back three paces.
My blade is not quick, but heavy.

lines.zh: 火苗从我的头窜到你身上。
lines.en: Flame leaps from my head onto you.

lines.zh: 我藤蔓一收，你骨头就响了。
lines.en: The vines tighten and your bones creak.
I press you down into the mud.

lines.zh: 这一刀砍在你的护肩上。
lines.en: This cut lands on your shoulder guard.
The vines are tightening, stop struggling.
I raise my arm and bring it down again.
Your blood waters my roots.
Fallen crops I never lift up.

lines.zh: 灵药泼在邪恶南瓜上，我来了。
lines.en: Elixir on the evil pumpkin, and here I am.
I was only a scarecrow before.

lines.zh: 火在头上点起来，我就醒了。
lines.en: A fire lit on my head and I woke.

lines.zh: 这一夜，地里的东西都活了。
lines.en: Tonight everything in the field woke up.

lines.zh: 我提着刀，从藤里站起来。
lines.en: I rise from the vines carrying a blade.
The pumpkins ripened, so I take the stage.
You finished the ritual, very good.

lines.zh: 我听见鼓声，从土里往上爬。
lines.en: I hear drums and climb up out of the soil.
Every seed is calling my name.

lines.zh: 我的蜡烛是自己点着的。
lines.en: My candle lit itself.
This field has a new master.
Autumn always has something to collect.

lines.zh: 我站在田埂上，等你很久。
lines.en: I stand on the ridge, waiting long for you.
Do not put out the light, I want to see you.

lines.zh: 灵药烧完，我从地里起身。
lines.en: The brew burns out; I rise from the soil.
The straw loosens and I pull out my legs.

lines.zh: 南瓜裂开一条缝，露出火。
lines.en: The pumpkin splits and fire shows through.

lines.zh: 夜露落在我肩上，我不擦。
lines.en: Night dew falls on my shoulders; I leave it.
Every bird in the field has flown off.

lines.zh: 我站起来，比篱笆高一个头。
lines.en: I stand a head taller than the fence.

lines.zh: 火对我没用，我本来就烧着。
lines.en: Fire is no use, I am already burning.

lines.zh: 摔得我南瓜里的蜡全泼了。
lines.en: The fall spilled all the wax in my head.
Water is seeping into my pumpkin.
The blast scattered my seeds everywhere.

lines.zh: 箭插在南瓜上，像根签子。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my pumpkin like a skewer.
Your spell means to put me out?
My roots are in soil, I do not starve.
Lightning fire, the same as mine.
I have fallen out of my own field.
